data.opportunityTitle: The National Network of STI Prevention Training Centers (NNPTC)
data.modifiedComments: The forecast has been modified to update the NOFO title from the current "The National Network of STI Clinical Prevention Training Centers (NNPTC)" to "The National Network of STI Prevention Training Centers (NNPTC". Additionally, in the description, we changed the term "disease intervention professionals" to "disease intervention specialists."

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: This NOFO will support the development and dissemination of education, training and technical assistanceemphasizing prevention strategiesfor clinicians and disease intervention specialists to improve sexually transmitted infection (STI) patient care.  The NOFO aims to improve the capacity of providers, clinical sites, and healthcare systems to diagnose, manage, treat and counsel individuals with and at-risk for STIs, in order to reduce STI morbidity and improve health on an individual, local and national level.
forecast.estApplicationResponseDateDesc: Electronically submitted applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 pm ET on the listed application due date.
